networks.name: Onflow Ads Cross-Promotion
networks.how_it_works: Opt-in partner directory/open board; the platform bot publishes both approved promotional posts, checks them, and removes them when the run ends.
networks.notes: Free 1:1 swaps are automatically published by @OnflowAdsBot, checked during the agreed run, and removed at the end. Requires a free account and adding the bot as an administrator to our public channel. Paid extras are excluded.
networks.reason: Official documentation confirms free, automated post swaps and a free plan allowance; post publishing and removal are handled by the bot.
networks.required_one_time_setup: Create platform account and add @OnflowAdsBot to @cryptoping_ru with only the post/delete rights required for cross-promotion.
networks.verified_limits: Official guide says the Free plan allows 5 new cross-promotions per month; joining swaps started by others remains free.

networks.name: Adpact Cross-Promotion
networks.how_it_works: Opt-in partner discovery; posts are published and checked by the platform bot. Exchanges consume/earn in-app points.
networks.notes: Both owners review/accept posts. No ad purchase required, but points and platform eligibility rules apply.
networks.reason: Official site confirms no-cash post swaps, automatic bot publication and delivery checks; platform points are used instead of money.
networks.required_one_time_setup: Connect the public channel to Adpact and use only its cross-promotion flow; inspect current point cost before accepting a swap.
networks.verified_limits: No cash payment for the exchange, but accepted swaps consume in-app points.

networks.name: Trigram Cross-Promotion
networks.how_it_works: The service matches channel owners for post swaps, publishes through its bot, and checks that both posts remain live for the agreed period.
networks.notes: The public catalog also contains paid placements; only the cross-promotion path is in scope.
networks.reason: Official site describes free channel-to-channel swaps, matched by subscriber range, language and topic, with bot publication and verification.
networks.required_one_time_setup: Connect the channel to Trigram and enable the free cross-promotion route; do not activate paid listing or ad-placement options.
networks.verified_limits: Official site says cross-promotion has no minimum subscriber count and no listing fee.

networks.name: CrossPromer

networks.reason: Public bot description explicitly advertises joint free campaigns; scheduling/publication details need live confirmation.
networks.required_one_time_setup: Check the bot workflow and permissions before connecting anything.

networks.name: Erzy Cross Promotion
networks.notes: Public bot description says it helps channel admins run cross-promotions. Free terms and current activity need confirmation.
networks.reason: Public bot listings describe free cross-promotion; an app directory also mentions agreement-based compensation in some conditions, so terms should be reviewed first.
networks.required_one_time_setup: Review the current terms and any growth/compensation obligations before connecting.

networks.name: TelegrAd / Telegrad.Link
networks.how_it_works: Bot/MiniApp supports automatically scheduled multi-channel keypads and reciprocal post swaps. The bot publishes posts, checks results and tracks subscriber changes.
networks.notes: Free start and basic plan confirmed by official site. One-time setup requires adding @telegradlinkbot as a channel/group admin with posting rights and registering @cryptoping_ru. Free-plan limits and whether keypads have extra restrictions need checking in the live app.
networks.reason: Official site states getting started is free; scheduled keypads and cross-promo posts are published automatically by the bot.
networks.required_one_time_setup: Connect @cryptoping_ru in the MiniApp and grant @telegradlinkbot only the publishing rights needed.
networks.verified_limits: Free start confirmed; exact ongoing free quota needs checking in the app.

networks.name: Tex.media Traffic Exchange
networks.how_it_works: Channel owners connect a channel, set placement parameters and exchange accumulated views for placements in other channels; posts are moderated and analytics are advertised.
networks.notes: Supplementary exposure route, not guaranteed subscriber acquisition. View exchange can bring lower-intent traffic than a topical post swap; test separately and measure joins/retention.
networks.reason: Free view exchange is advertised, but view-exchange traffic may be lower-intent; measure joins and retention separately.
networks.required_one_time_setup: Do not prioritize above genuine topic-matched post swaps.

networks.reason: Credits are earned by watching ads or completing tasks; this does not meet the no-participation requirement by default.
networks.required_one_time_setup: Exclude unless it offers a fully passive free placement mechanism.

networks.name: Onflow Ads Subscriber Exchange
networks.reason: The official guide confirms an automatic reciprocal ad exchange: once our channel hosts other members' ads, our own ad can run across theirs. No money moves between channels; the platform posts and removes ads automatically.
networks.required_one_time_setup: Create a free account, connect @cryptoping_ru and select allowed categories/content before starting. Ads require a publishing bot in our channel.
networks.verified_limits: Free route is confirmed, but free-plan placement and hosting quotas vary by plan. The system is host-first; it is not fully free of ongoing inventory obligations.
networks.notes: This is more passive than one-to-one post swapping, but it introduces third-party ads into @cryptoping_ru. Start only with strict allow/deny filters and review of the ad categories; do not allow unrelated scams, adult material, fake engagement or irrelevant financial claims.

networks.name: Lyzem FreePromo

directories.submission_status: free form found; not submitted

directories.name: OpenTG
directories.submission_status: public-channel indexing advertised; @cryptoping_ru indexing not verified
directories.notes: Search engine creates public web pages for public Telegram posts; posts over 200 characters are indexed. Public channels may be indexed automatically, while adding @opentg_collector_bot can explicitly connect a channel. This improves web discoverability rather than guaranteeing subscribers.

directories.name: Telegram Search Engine
directories.submission_status: free submit path advertised; not submitted
directories.notes: Public directory advertises free channel submission and automated verification. Validate current form and quality before submission; no paid upgrade is in scope.

execution_notes.critical_limitation: Finding a channel whose rules permit promotion is not the same as being authorized to post there. A publisher must already be a member with permission, or an exchange platform must have its bot connected to both channels.
execution_notes.current_live_status: Targets discovered only. No third-party group has been joined, no promo post has been published, and no subscriber increase is claimed.
execution_notes.next_automation_step: Connect an authorized Telegram publishing identity once, then process eligible targets sequentially with rate limits, duplicate suppression, rules checks and per-target conversion tracking.
